data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 were $446.119m. During 2015 there was an adverse prior-year development (gross) of approximately $23.366m (about 5.2% of opening reserves), driven by adverse development in older underwriting years (2008-2013). The movement reflects a combination of large man-made losses (notably in Energy and Aviation portfolios) and recalibration of IBNR/reserving estimates, partially offset at net level by reinsurance recoveries.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims Outstanding) 2014 comparative column. Prior-year development (gross) was computed from the gross claims development triangle (Notes: 'Estimate of incurred gross claims' table) by comparing each older underwriting year's current estimate to its previous diagonal (excluded 2014 and 2015). The report also states a net release ($6.284m) but that is NET of reinsurance; the triangle-derived gross PYD of +$23.366m (strengthening) was used as the primary prior-year movement. Amounts are in the report's native currency (USD). Some event years and LOB mappings are inferred where the report names incidents but does not explicitly assign underwriting years or gross impacts; these have lower confidence.
